models.title: Defined benefit plan deficit or surplus
models.summary: The example subtracts plan asset fair value from the present value of the defined benefit obligation.

relationship.original_equation: Defined benefit deficit = present value of obligation - fair value of plan assets
relationship.translation_notes: Positive deficit is underfunding; a negative value is surplus. Values can be scaled consistently.

assumptions: The obligation and eligible plan assets are measured at the same reporting date for the same plan.
Inputs follow the applicable accounting definitions and are stated in the same currency.
limitations: A negative output denotes a surplus before application of any asset ceiling, not necessarily the recognized net pension asset.
Reimbursement rights that do not qualify as plan assets are excluded.
